title: HttpRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Calls an independently served unit over HTTP behind the runtime contract.

inputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.constructor.url
inputs.description: The exact URL that every invoke call POSTs its JSON request to, with no path added. The constructor does not check it, so a malformed URL fails on each call as 'runtime-unavailable' rather than when the adapter is built.

inputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.constructor.options
inputs.description: Carries only the optional timeoutMs, the longest in milliseconds that one invoke call may take; a missing or null value falls back to defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs (30000 ms), and no other value is checked. Defaults to {}.

inputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.invoke.request
inputs.description: The request sent as the POST body: an operation name and an optional input. It must be portable JSON, meaning finite numbers, well-formed strings, plain objects and arrays nested no deeper than 64 levels; anything else anywhere in it makes invoke resolve with 'invalid-json' and nothing is sent.

outputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.invoke
outputs.description: Resolves with a RuntimeResponse and reports every failure as an ok: false value instead of rejecting. A valid unit envelope is returned as received, whatever the HTTP status; every other outcome is 'invalid-json', 'runtime-timeout', 'runtime-unavailable', 'runtime-failed' or 'invalid-response'.

outputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.close
outputs.description: Resolves with no value and does nothing: the adapter holds no connection or other resource, and close does not cancel an invoke that is already in flight.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when options is null, because the constructor reads options.timeoutMs from it; only an undefined options is replaced by the default {}. The url is stored unchecked, so a bad url is never a reason for this error.

outputs.name: HttpRuntimeAdapter.constructor
outputs.description: The new HttpRuntimeAdapter, a UnitRuntime whose kind is 'http'. It keeps the url and the timeout it resolved from options: options.timeoutMs, or defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs (30000 ms) when that is missing or null.
